sloka: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति ।क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम् ।। ५.६६.१० ।।।।
transliteration: ciraṁ jīvati vaidehī yadi māsaṁ dhariṣyati ।kṣaṇaṁ saumya na jīveyaṁ vinā tāmasitekṣaṇām ।। 5.66.10 ।।।।

translations.english: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.
